findings.title: Mutable stage marker selects the pre-transfer path and teardown despite actual receiver registration
findings.evidence: Source inspection: after the actual _OWNERS registration transfers custody, clearing stages._effect_admission selects the original require_current path and removes the inspect/stage_item transferred-custody refusal. Before public effects, original stage currentness can still hold. The same mutable marker gates _revoke in actual stage-finally, so clearing it also skips removing the actual receiver registration and associated retained references.
findings.consequence: One-way stage custody and actual registration lifetime are not enforced independently of the marker. Public receiver operations still compare the original registry nonce and refuse a mismatched marker; this finding does not establish unauthorized public publication.
findings.required_change: Select dispatch and transferred-custody refusal from actual receiver registration, retaining the original nonce check. Revoke actual receiver registration at actual stage teardown independently of mutable marker state. Never fall back to the pre-transfer path for a registered receiver with missing or mismatched marker.
findings.verification: Source-only state-transition finding; no bespoke probe or new independent maintained execution performed.
